hook: delude 是騙你，deluge 是淹你，divulge 是洩漏——工作室三個噴嘴：謊言、洪水、祕密。
script: delude＝欺騙。deluge＝洪水／大量湧來。divulge＝洩露。保全：別被騙、別被淹、別爆料。

members.senseAnchor: be false to; be dishonest with
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 謊言噴: delude walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「謊言噴」出場：delude 一上場梗就黏住——欺騙。

members.senseAnchor: an overwhelming number or amount; a heavy rain
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 洪水閥: deluge walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「洪水閥」出場：deluge 一上場梗就黏住——洪水氾濫。

related.synonyms: flood, inundation, torrent, downpour, cloudburst, waterspout

members.senseAnchor: make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
